|---|---|---|

| #609 | `fix/npc-summons-peer-dressing` | `crates/er-npc-summons/src/mimic_hooks.rs` at lines 499, 570, 637 and 701 |

Formatting and committing both wait for your reply, and each reply pays for one commit, so I need it twice, once per branch:

authorize commit
